note: Reconstruction of the HDGM MMD-FUSE power experiment for Figure 4(a). The released notebook power loop used the correct changing sample sizes but omitted d=2 when calling sample_hdgm_semi_t2, therefore silently using the sampler default d=10. This run explicitly sets d=2. For compatibility with the current NumPy/JAX environment, the HDGM sampler uses the outer trial index i as its integer seed (kk=i), while the original two-split JAX RNG sequence is retained and the second subkey is passed to mmdfuse. No MMD-FUSE hyperparameters are tuned.
